name: mecasermin
warnings: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Hypoglycemia: Severe hypoglycemia leading to hypoglycemic seizures has been observed with INCRELEX treatment. Administer INCRELEX shortly before or after a meal or snack, because it has insulin-like hypoglycemic effects. ( 5.1 ) Hypersensitivity and Allergic Reactions, inc
